subject: FB-3b/seaborn-compare: opus vs sonnet KB, full export, side by side
description: Produce a FAIR opus-vs-sonnet KB comparison for seaborn (mwaskom/seaborn @ 7001ebe7), applying all hard-won fixes. Output two FULL exported blocks: bench/featurebench-kb/seaborn.opus.AGENTS.md and bench/featurebench-kb/seaborn.sonnet.AGENTS.md. Bakes in: ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 (so the nested learner can write onboard-notes.json — note-mqfj0lgtpk5), foreground clone into the worktree (not /tmp, not background — background sandbox loses /tmp), inject to the repo's OWN .graph workspace, verify by export-kb read-back (NOT live search_knowledge), and FULL export via --k 100 --min-score 0 (the default single-query/0.1 under-recalls — only ~3-7 of N notes surface). One worker runs onboard twice (opus + sonnet) into two distinct workspaces, exports both fully, commits both. This is the comparison artifact before deciding whether to scale to all 5 repos x 2 models.
